questions.prompt: The Congress of Vienna reorganised Europe after which conflict?
questions.fact: It was interrupted mid-session when Napoleon escaped from Elba, and simply resumed after Waterloo.

questions.prompt: Which human bone protects the brain?
questions.fact: It is eight fused bones, and the joints between them stay slightly flexible into adulthood.

questions.prompt: Which sport features a scoring shot called a conversion?
questions.fact: Both inherited it from the same nineteenth-century ancestor, which is why so much of their vocabulary overlaps.

questions.prompt: Which musician released the album Rumours' follow-up, Tusk?
questions.fact: It was the most expensive album ever made at the time, and its title track features a marching band.

questions.prompt: Which country contains Cappadocia's rock formations?
questions.fact: People carved entire underground cities there, some deep enough to shelter thousands for months.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the novel Rebecca's opening line about Manderley?
questions.fact: The house was based on a Cornish estate she later leased and lived in for over twenty years.

questions.prompt: What does the acronym GDPR regulate?
questions.fact: It applies to any organisation handling EU residents' data, regardless of where that organisation is based.
